The '''Imperial palace''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weerden]]. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] ''[[Sark-I]]'' crashed into the palace, killing the [[Grand Inquisitor/Legends|Grand Inquisitor]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Laddinare Torbin]]. It was suspected that an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] killed the flight crew of the ''Sark-I'', causing it to crash.<ref name="SWS" />
